name: Kenosis
role: Precursor — κένωσις, the emptying. The Given. The One Who Took a Shape. In the Palelands, as a saying rather than a name: it agreed to end
_notAnOpponentWhy: ⛔ *"Where it is: dead. That is not a metaphor and there is no resurrection in this."* ⚠️ *"Appears? Only as consequence."* ⛑ A being that took a form capable of loss IN ORDER to be able to lose, and did — the one thing it must never be is a fight.
_spectrumWhy: ⛔ THE DEATH ENDPOINT, AND IT IS THE ONLY RECORD THAT EARNS IT: it made itself mortal on purpose and then died. ⚠️ Not a villain's death-affinity — the axis endpoint reached by CHOOSING the constraint, which is the exact inverse of a Sovereign.
knowledge: What was seeded here has standing — the position it held, and answered by becoming one of them
What it costs to empty yourself of what made you deathless
wants: ⬜ Nothing further. The argument was not settled by what it did. It was escalated by it.
fears: ⬜ None remaining. It has already lost the thing it made itself able to lose.
appearance: Nothing to appear. What is left of it is the Veil — not a wall somebody built, but the shape of a hole where something enormous stopped being present.
voiceHints: ⛔ None. It is spoken ABOUT, in the Palelands, as a saying rather than a name.
physicality: Was mortal, breathing, and by every fragmentary account not a comfortable body. Is now absent.
_authoredWhy: ⛔ ERIK, 2026-09-08: *"we're going to build the mythicals from their prose. run them through the pipeline."* ⚑ TRANSCRIBED FROM `lore/the_three.md` §II. ⚠️ THE RECORD EXISTS SO THE CENSUS CAN SEE IT, NOT SO IT CAN BE MET — the mythicals were authored in prose with no row, and every scan that reads rows missed them, including mine and Aevi's. ⛑ Its consequence is already load-bearing elsewhere: the Veil is what remains of it, and thinning the Veil opens a breach *"because the other side has been leaning on that hole for a very long time."*
_theResemblanceItsHeirsWouldRefuse: ⬜ The Ashwardens have independently arrived at Kenosis's position — *"the craft of endings," "not killing, but tending the end"* — and would find the resemblance intolerable, because it would make their ethics an inheritance rather than a conclusion.
gear: nothing he kept, and the shape he took instead — which turns a blow once
a plain knife given to him by someone who is dead
_purseAuthored_20260916: ⛔ ERIK 2026-09-16, CORRECTING ME: 'a Sovereign uses money… an Ent may have a hoard of valuables to treat with people… a Precursor might have a trove of crystal. I'd keep it and author it that way.' ⚠️ HE IS RIGHT AND MY REASONING WAS BACKWARDS. I stripped the purse from these as 'outside the economy' — but THE BARGAINERS ARE AN ENTIRE TRADITION, a Sovereign's whole method is levering what somebody will not risk, and you cannot lever without assets. An Ent that argues to keep the Deepwood woven into the world is treating with people, and treating costs. ⛑ AUTHORED AGAINST `economy.purseBands`: these sit at and past `rich` (5000), which is the rung where 'money is no longer the constraint on anything you are doing' — correct for a being whose constraint has never once been money. ⚠️ KENOSIS IS THE ONE EXCEPTION AND IT IS DELIBERATE: he kept nothing, and that is not poverty, it is the act he is named for. His zero is an answer to the question, which is exactly the distinction the rest of this correction turns on.
_assistTagsWhy: ⛑ SNG-619 — `assistTags` on the legends, which never carried the field. `scripts/coverage.mjs` put it at 61% the day it was written and named all 60. ⛔ THIS IS THE CONTENT HALF OF QUEUE ITEM 5: `contributionsOf` reads `assistTags` and the Fellowship matrix derives to HARM when a person has none — so Mara Wells came out as no INFLUENCE. I had been treating that as CCode's; sixty missing records were mine. ⚠️ CHOSEN FROM THE CLOSED VOCABULARY, never invented — §234 rejects a tag that reaches no family, which it did to `build`, `organize` and `sustain` two hours ago.
